items.title: UP assistant teacher recruitment exam to proceed as scheduled
items.summary: Uttar Pradesh commission confirms assistant teacher recruitment exam will proceed as planned after fake cancellation notice circulated using official…
items.content_text:
The Uttar Pradesh commission has confirmed the assistant teacher recruitment examination will be held as scheduled. Deputy Secretary stated that unauthorized individuals misused the commission's official letterhead, logo and name to circulate a fake notice claiming the exam was cancelled.
- Exam to proceed as originally scheduled
- Fake cancellation notice circulated using commission letterhead
- Deputy Secretary confirms notice was fraudulent
- Unauthorized elements misused official logo and name

items.title: Cyclone Akvan weakens, set to hit Odisha-Andhra coast today
items.summary: Cyclone Akvan weakened to a cyclonic storm and is expected to cross the Odisha-Andhra Pradesh coast on Friday, moving at 21 kmph over the Bay of Bengal.
items.content_text:
Cyclone Akvan has weakened into a cyclonic storm and is likely to make landfall along the Odisha-Andhra Pradesh coast on Friday. The India Meteorological Department reported the storm moving north-northwest at 21 kmph, centered over the west-central Bay of Bengal at 2:30 am.
- Cyclone Akvan weakened to cyclonic storm status
- Expected to cross Odisha-Andhra coast on Friday
- Moving north-northwest at 21 kmph over six hours
- Centered over west-central Bay of Bengal at 2:30 am

items.title: Anthropic raises $81.3 billion in IPO despite $104 billion loss
items.summary: Anthropic priced shares at $83 and sold more than planned as Claude Code drove revenue growth, though the company reported a massive net loss.
items.content_text:
Anthropic completed its initial public offering, raising $81.3 billion by pricing shares at $83 and selling more shares than originally planned. The company's revenue surged on the popularity of its Claude Code product, but it simultaneously reported a net loss of $104 billion.
- Anthropic raised $81.3 billion in its IPO
- Shares priced at $83 with oversubscribed offering
- Revenue grew as Claude Code gained popularity
- Company reported $104 billion net loss

items.title: Police Ask Top Lashkar Commander Latief Bhat To Surrender In J&K
items.summary: Police in Jammu and Kashmir asked top Lashkar-e-Taiba commander Latief Bhat to surrender over a video call after his accomplice was killed in Kulgam.
items.content_text:
Police in Jammu and Kashmir have asked Latief Bhat, described as a top commander of Lashkar-e-Taiba, to surrender through a video call. The appeal follows an encounter in Kulgam on Monday in which his accomplice, Umar Nisar Dar, was killed. Bhat is reported to be trapped in the region.
- Latief Bhat is described as a top commander of Lashkar-e-Taiba.
- Police asked him to surrender during a video call.
- His accomplice, Umar Nisar Dar, was killed in an encounter in Kulgam.
- The encounter took place on Monday, according to the source.
- Bhat is reported to be trapped in Jammu and Kashmir.

items.title: RBI to auction 91-day, 182-day and 364-day Treasury Bills on Nov 18
items.summary: The Reserve Bank of India will auction three Treasury Bills worth a total of ₹23,000 crore on November 18, 2026, with settlement on November 19.
items.content_text:
The Reserve Bank of India has announced an auction of three Government of India Treasury Bills on November 18, 2026, totalling ₹23,000 crore. The 91-day and 182-day bills are notified at ₹8,000 crore each, and the 364-day bill at ₹7,000 crore. Settlement is on November 19, 2026.
- The 91-day and 182-day bills are notified at ₹8,000 crore each.
- The 364-day bill is notified at ₹7,000 crore, taking the total to ₹23,000 crore.
- Bids will be submitted electronically on the RBI's E-Kuber system on November 18.
- Retail investors can bid non-competitively, capped at 5 percent of the notified amount.
- Successful bidders must pay on November 19, 2026.
